data.name: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL
data.detailed_description:
THE OCCULT PROTOCOL is a paranormal investigation horror game playable solo or in online co-op. Explore haunted locations, gather evidence, identify the entity haunting them, survive its manifestations, and perform the ritual required to banish it.

Every investigation confronts you with a supernatural presence whose behavior must be understood. Observe your surroundings, use specialized equipment, and connect the phenomena you witness to uncover what is hiding there before the situation spirals out of control.

INVESTIGATE THE PARANORMAL

Use a range of investigation tools to detect anomalies, reveal hidden traces, and gather the evidence required to identify the entity.

No single clue tells the whole story. Analyze paranormal activity, compare your observations, and determine what is hunting you.

SURVIVE THE HUNTS

As supernatural activity intensifies, the entity becomes increasingly dangerous.

When a hunt begins, it can pursue you through the environment, remember your last known position, and search for you. Break line of sight, find somewhere to hide, and use the environment to stay alive.

PREPARE THE RITUAL

Identifying the entity is only the beginning.

Gather the required equipment, prepare the ritual area, and complete the different steps of the protocol to attempt to banish the presence for good.

Poor preparation may turn the ritual into your final mistake.

YOU ARE NOT DEFENSELESS

Some equipment can repel, slow, or temporarily incapacitate supernatural entities. Salt-loaded weapons, holy water, incense, and other occult tools may buy you the few seconds you need to survive.

But THE OCCULT PROTOCOL is not a shooter. Understanding what you are facing remains your greatest weapon.

PLAY SOLO OR ONLINE CO-OP

Conduct investigations alone or work together with other investigators online. Divide your equipment, search for evidence, and coordinate when supernatural activity becomes uncontrollable.

ENTER THE PROTOCOL

Investigate. Identify. Prepare. Survive. Banish.

Every presence leaves traces.
Understand them before it is too late.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6600 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Estimated for 1920x1080, Medium settings, 30 FPS target, ray tracing disabled. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 12 GB or AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT 16 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Estimated for 1920x1080, High settings, 60 FPS target, ray tracing disabled. Hardware ray tracing is optional and requires a more powerful GPU. SSD recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains horror themes, dark and unsettling environments, frightening supernatural entities, intense chase sequences, and fictional violence. Players may use weapons and defensive equipment against hostile entities, and the player character can be killed during encounters. The game may include disturbing imagery, corpses, occult themes, rituals, and psychological horror elements. It does not contain sexual content or explicit gore
